title: A multi-scale analysis of the CzrA transcription repressor highlights the allosteric changes induced by metal ion binding
authors: Marta Rigoli; Raffaello Potestio; Roberto Menichetti
one_liner_zh: 该文通过微秒级MD模拟和MEOW信息论方法分析CzrA转录抑制因子的变构调控，聚焦金属离子结合对DNA结合区力学性质的影响，属于TF-DNA互作体系但未直接建模DNA结合，方法可迁移至本课题。
abstract: Allosteric regulation is a widespread strategy employed by several proteins to transduce chemical signals and perform biological functions. Metal sensor proteins are exemplary in this respect, e.g., in that they selectively bind and unbind DNA depending on the state of a distal ion coordination site. In this work, we carry out an investigation of the structural and mechanical properties of the CzrA transcription repressor through the analysis of microsecond-long molecular dynamics (MD) trajectories; the latter are processed through the mapping entropy optimisation workflow (MEOW), a recently developed information-theoretical method that highlights, in an unsupervised manner, residues of particular mechanical, functional, and biological importance. This approach allows us to unveil how differences in the properties of the molecule are controlled by the state of the zinc coordination site, with particular attention to the DNA binding region. These changes correlate with a redistribution of the conformational variability of the residues throughout the molecule, in spite of an overall consistency of its architecture in the two (ion-bound and free) coordination states. The results of this work corroborate previous studies, provide novel insight into the fine details of the mechanics of CzrA, and showcase the MEOW approach as a novel instrument for the study of allosteric regulation and other processes in proteins through the analysis of plain MD simulations.
abstract_zh: 别构调控是多种蛋白质用以转导化学信号并执行生物功能的普遍策略。金属传感器蛋白在这方面尤为典型，例如，它们根据远端离子配位位点的状态选择性结合或解离DNA。在本工作中，我们通过分析微秒级分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）轨迹，研究了CzrA转录抑制因子的结构和力学性质；这些轨迹通过映射熵优化工作流（mapping entropy optimisation workflow, MEOW）处理，这是一种近期发展的信息论方法，能够以无监督方式突出具有特殊力学、功能和生物学重要性的残基。该方法使我们得以揭示锌配位位点状态如何控制分子性质的差异，特别关注DNA结合区域。这些变化与整个分子中残基构象变异性的重新分布相关，尽管在两种（离子结合和游离）配位状态下其整体架构保持一致。本工作的结果证实了先前研究，为CzrA力学细节提供了新见解，并展示了MEOW方法作为通过分析普通MD模拟研究蛋白质别构调控及其他过程的新工具。
